notes.title: Toushin Gent Release!
notes.content:
Hello friends and fans. It's Toushin Gent's launch!

We will be keeping an eye on things for a while after launch, so we encourage everyone to leave their thoughts in a review, and to post any bugs they run into.
For those reading this who wish to upgrade their saves from the demo version:
1. Go to local files for the demo, copy the save files you wish to copy from "DemoSave"
2. Paste those into the "Save" folder in the local files of the full game
3. Launch the game and the saves will be upgraded (The new saves won't be recognized if you try to copy them over while the game is running)

notes.title: Toushin Gent release to be delayed to March
notes.content:
The release date of Toushin Gent will be delayed from January 2025 to March 2025.

We apologize to our numerous fans which may have been looking forward to playing Toushin Gent in January, but we would not have been able to release the game as-is with confidence that it would be a complete realization of the experience we had planned and promised to deliver.

This delay will give us the time needed to complete all planned content without rushing things, and to ensure that the game is fully tested.
There will be no further delays, and the specific release date will be made visible by the end of February.
Yippee.
